name: glb-designer-stage9a
description: Asset Studio Stage 9a — 'Make parts editable' decomposes ANY catalog def (here the procedural 'dining-chair' primitive) into editable mesh parts + groups via window.__glbDesigner.makePartsEditable(defId). Asserts parts/groups landed, mutates the spec to explode one part far on +X and recolour another, then screenshots the decomposed/mid-edit piece.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: decompose-dining-chair
steps.comment: Kick off makePartsEditable on the procedural 'dining-chair' def. Must NOT return the promise itself — page.evaluate awaits a returned promise, and the multi-RAF offscreen decompose can outlive the CDP round-trip ('Promise was collected'). Stash it on window and return undefined instead; the following waitFor gates on the resulting spec.

steps.name: wait-decomposed

waitFor.store: (() => { const s = window.__glbDesigner && window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); return !!s && Array.isArray(s.parts) && s.parts.length > 0; })()

steps.failMessage: makePartsEditable('dining-chair') never populated spec.parts — offscreen procedural decompose may not work headlessly

steps.name: assert-parts-and-groups
steps.comment: The dining-chair primitive has several distinct meshes (seat, back, 4 legs, ...) so decompose should yield multiple parts, and repeated parts (the 4 legs) should merge into at least one PartGroup.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const partCount = s.parts.length; const groupCount = (s.partGroups || []).length; console.log('9A_DECOMPOSE parts='+partCount+' groups='+groupCount+' ids='+JSON.stringify(s.parts.map(p => p.id))); if (partCount < 1) throw new Error('expected >=1 part, got '+partCount); window.__nineA = { partCount, groupCount }; })()

steps.name: render-decomposed
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__glbDesignerThree; if (t) t.gl.render(t.scene, t.camera); })()

steps.name: explode-and-recolour
steps.comment: Mutate the spec directly via getSpec/setSpec: move the LAST part far on +X (a leg or the back — 'exploded' proof) and recolour the FIRST part a vivid hex. Record the before/after for assertions.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); const movedId = s.parts[s.parts.length - 1].id; const recolouredId = s.parts[0].id; const before = s.parts.find(p => p.id === movedId).position.slice(); const movedPart = s.parts.find(p => p.id === movedId); movedPart.position = [before[0] + 0.6, before[1], before[2]]; const recolouredPart = s.parts.find(p => p.id === recolouredId); recolouredPart.color = '#ff2e6b'; window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); window.__nineA = Object.assign(window.__nineA || {}, { movedId, recolouredId, beforePos: before, expectedX: before[0] + 0.6 }); })()

steps.name: wait-exploded

waitFor.store: (() => { const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const p = s.parts.find(p => p.id === window.__nineA.movedId); return !!p && Math.abs(p.position[0] - window.__nineA.expectedX) < 1e-6; })()

steps.failMessage: moved part position did not update after setSpec

steps.name: assert-explode-and-recolour
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const moved = s.parts.find(p => p.id === window.__nineA.movedId); const recoloured = s.parts.find(p => p.id === window.__nineA.recolouredId); if (Math.abs(moved.position[0] - window.__nineA.expectedX) > 1e-6) throw new Error('moved part x mismatch: '+moved.position[0]+' vs expected '+window.__nineA.expectedX); if (recoloured.color !== '#ff2e6b') throw new Error('recolour did not apply, got '+recoloured.color); console.log('9A_MUTATE movedX='+moved.position[0]+' recolour='+recoloured.color); })()

steps.name: render-exploded
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__glbDesignerThree; if (t) t.gl.render(t.scene, t.camera); })()

steps.name: render-exploded-2
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__glbDesignerThree; if (t) t.gl.render(t.scene, t.camera); })()

steps.name: click-top-view
steps.comment: Re-frame from Top so the whole scene (including the far-displaced part, now well outside the original chair footprint) refits into view — bounds.refresh() re-includes the moved part's new position, unlike the perspective shot above which can crop it off-canvas.

steps.name: render-top
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__glbDesignerThree; if (t) t.gl.render(t.scene, t.camera); })()
